name: Thiruvananthapuram
description: Capital city known for the historic Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple, seaside cliff beaches of Varkala, Kovalam coast, and Napier Museum.

name: Kollam
description: Historic port city serving as the southern gateway to the Ashtamudi Lake backwaters, Munroe Island canal networks, and the Jatayu Earth's Center.

name: Pathanamthitta
description: Spiritual and eco-tourism hub known as the transit base for Sabarimala pilgrimage, Gavi rainforests, and handmade Aranmula metal mirrors.

name: Alappuzha
description: Renowned as the Venice of the East, famous for tranquil backwater cruises on traditional houseboats, Punnamada Lake, and serene Marari Beach.

name: Kottayam
description: Bordered by Vembanad Lake, celebrated for rubber plantations, Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary backwaters, and heritage Syrian Christian churches.

name: Idukki
description: Highland district in the Western Ghats home to Munnar tea plantations, Eravikulam National Park (Nilgiri Tahr), and the massive Idukki Arch Dam.

name: Ernakulam
description: Commercial heart of Kerala encompassing historic Kochi, Fort Kochi colonial quarters, iconic Chinese fishing nets, and Mattancherry spice markets.

name: Thrissur
description: The cultural capital of Kerala, famed for the grand Thrissur Pooram temple festival, ancient Vadakkunnathan Temple, and traditional performing arts.

name: Palakkad
description: The granary of Kerala framed by the Western Ghats gap, known for the 18th-century granite Palakkad Fort and virgin rainforests of Silent Valley.

name: Malappuram
description: Coastal and hilly terrain rich in Malabar culture, historic teak reserves of Nilambur, and traditional ayurvedic healing at Kottakkal Arya Vaidya Sala.

name: Kozhikode
description: Historic spice trade port where Vasco da Gama landed, celebrated for Malabar cuisine, Beypore wooden dhow shipbuilding, and Kappad Beach.

name: Wayanad
description: Misty highland plateau known for lush spice estates, Chembra Peak heart-shaped lake, prehistoric Edakkal Cave petroglyphs, and wildlife reserves.

name: Kannur
description: The Land of Looms and Lores, renowned for sacred Theyyam ritual dance performances, Muzhappilangad drive-in beach, and historic St. Angelo Fort.

name: Kasaragod
description: Northernmost coastal border district featuring the seaside laterite battlements of Bekal Fort, coir crafts, and quiet backwater waterways.
